_meta.note: A repeated query parameter must not 500. firstString(v) coerces a possibly-array param to its first value, so ?event=a&event=b honours 'a'. Applied to both `event` and `tags`.
_meta.currentBehavior: lib/events-api.js:17 calls req.query.event.split(' OR '). Express parses ?event=a&event=b into an array, so .split is undefined → TypeError → 500. Identical defect for `tags` at line 23.
_meta.helper: firstString(v: unknown): string => Array.isArray(v) ? String(v[0] ?? '') : typeof v === 'string' ? v : ''

cases.name: repeated-event-with-OR-syntax-preserved
cases.note: The first value keeps its normal ' OR ' splitting — firstString only collapses the repeat, it does not change filter semantics.

cases.name: empty-repeated-event-is-no-filter
cases.note: String(v[0] ?? '') on an empty first value yields '', which is falsy and therefore applies no event filter — the same as omitting the parameter.

mustNotHappen.reason: A 500 from a well-formed repeated query parameter is the defect. If any case above returns 500 the rewrite has preserved D4.
